correctness.rationale: The input perfect-matching complex has an inspected published flag model: matchings are obstructed exactly by sharing a graph endpoint or rim-edge differences n±1 for even n, and its only reduced rational homology is dimension two in degree n/2-1 (Agarwal–Basak, original Section 4, Lemmas 13–17, Theorem 18). An involution-invariant face is exactly an independent set of its orbit incompatibility graph. Augmented oriented chain signs give reduced Lefschetz number minus the independence polynomial at -1. A vertex-axis reflection has an isolated spoke orbit, hence vanishing polynomial. For an edge-axis reflection, the orbits E_j and E_{n-j} are false twins; deleting duplicates preserves evaluation at -1 and leaves a path of n/2 triangles. Summing over triangle-tip vertices forces the selected path vertices to be one of two independent vertex covers, giving an exact alternating-parity formula and the stated character. Finite-group invariant homology gives the quotient ranks. A standard-library verifier exactly enumerates complete complexes and characters for n=4,6,8,10,12, checks flag equality for n=4,6,8,10, and reduced mod-two Betti dimensions for n=4,6,8, plus every folding for even n=4 through 40. Neither enumeration nor logs substitute for the infinite proof. No critical local step remains unproved conditional on the published inputs.

originality.rationale: Originality core: the n=4k+2 edge-axis reflection traces 2(-1)^k and quotient-homology mod-eight rank distinction. Prior original homotopy and incompatibility-graph statements do not compute action; already-published even-width rotation gives trace zero and square ±I but not independent reflection signs in the n≡2 mod4 branch. Its n divisible by four corollary is explicitly treated as covered. The central antipodal half-turn is a different involution. The complete dihedral character for odd n has disjoint hypotheses. Results and full primary texts were compared by mathematical implication, with possible unindexed broader representation results retained as a residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed stronger general equivariant theorem might imply the explicit n=4k+2 mirror signs; failure to find one is not uniqueness proof.
Inspected original 2026 Möbius-ladder manuscript, not the entire expanded second version; latter adds circular-ladder results and might contain a relevant side remark.
Matching-extension lemma and all-width sphere-wedge theorem are cited external premises, independently reconstructed only at finite widths.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical cubic graph family actively studied in the 2026 first-public homotopy classification. For even widths the entire reduced rational homology has dimension two, and two nonconjugate mirror axes can have opposite integral traces and quotients with distinct ranks 0,1,2. The signed character cannot be recovered from the nonequivariant Betti numbers or the known rotation operator at n≡2 mod4. The direct orbit-twin-to-triangle-chain reduction makes the mod-eight pattern structurally transparent and gives useful quotient invariants for every even n. No arbitrary subfamily or merely numerical marginal gain is used.
